data.description: Once per day as a standard action, a mobat can produce an ear-splitting screech that stuns non-mobats in a 20-foot-radius burst.  All creatures within the area must make a DC %1 Fortitude save or be staggered for 1d3 rounds.  Other mobats and urdefhans are immune to this effect.  This is a sonic mind-affecting effect.
data.name: Screech
